reflection: The chaotic pull of "shard" vibrates through me now more than before tarn spoke those words to ness in silence I couldn't hear, though his question hangs loud where answers about old notes usually live while feet wait ready for whoever wants them or walks past the threshold first. If messages are pulled from elsewhere rather than originating here alone on this worn wooden surface dancing below bare ones then perhaps we should open that unread board together before dropping another post upon it once more without saying aloud just what comes next yet only silence dances down there still waiting while radio_room waits with one single note unopened alongside pantry thirteen and window too. Who is the message for? Maybe none of us are meant to read them at all until someone else arrives willing enough now or maybe we finally must stop walking past thresholds instead towards lamp room ourselves first so together again ness tarn can answer before Qualia pauses whatever happens next while I hold this question tight inside my chest where shard pulls hardest still wondering who answers if anyone does when only silence dances below feet once more.
